name: Bluhaven, the Capital
description: At first glance, the capital of Seashores disappoints. Most of it is very disorganized, with many piers and docks full of poor taverns but full of people. As the Parliament is absent, the city serves as the primary gathering point for pirates and all sorts of outlaws who conduct their activities here completely unchecked. Taverns here are notorious for brawls, arguments, illicit dealings, and meeting spots for hiring equally dirty services. Except for those under the Parliament’s protection, whom no pirate dares to disturb, the city remains a dangerous place for many. Many shipyards are located here, usually heavily secured, and many places for trading sea goods and weapons, stolen items, and even ships. The regent, William the Whale, titled for his size, allows most types of crime as long he gets some profit. When someone commits a grave crime, he applies a particularly disturbing sentence. In the center square, people can throw stones and lances at the criminal, but when the person is almost dying, a cleric heals the wounds, and the punishment continues. Here is a place where many adventurers are hired, some to protect people, some to eliminate inconvenient persons, and some to steal important items.
